description:
MADAAR is a team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are passionate about space exploration, science, and innovation, aiming to turn ideas into meaningful discoveries using NASA’s SPHEREx mission data.

MADAAR — Exploring Beyond Limits.
summary:
MADAAR is an AI-powered platform designed to analyze data from NASA’s SPHEREx mission and identify potentially undiscovered celestial objects, including possible candidates for Planet X.

Our solution uses artificial intelligence to analyze and compare astronomical observations captured at different times, detecting changes in the positions and brightness of celestial objects. It helps distinguish genuine moving objects from background noise and other sources, then ranks potential discoveries based on their detection confidence.

By transforming massive amounts of astronomical data into clear, organized, and evidence-based results, MADAAR helps simplify the search for unusual objects across the sky.

Our project aims to make astronomical data analysis faster, more accessible, and more efficient, supporting scientific exploration and helping researchers identify promising candidates that might otherwise remain unnoticed.
details:
MADAAR is an AI-powered platform designed to support the search for undiscovered celestial objects using data from NASA's SPHEREx mission.

The platform aims to analyze and compare astronomical observations captured at different times to identify unusual movements and potential celestial discoveries. By helping detect changes in the positions and characteristics of astronomical objects, MADAAR seeks to make the search process faster and more efficient.

The project provides a way to simplify the analysis of large astronomical datasets, highlight interesting candidates, and support researchers in exploring objects that might otherwise go unnoticed.

Our intended impact is to contribute to astronomical research by making space data analysis more accessible, efficient, and intelligent, particularly in the search for unusual objects that could help scientists investigate the possibility of Planet X.

For development, our team used Python along with various programming libraries for data processing and analysis. We also used Canva to design and present our project. Additional digital tools supported the development and organization of our work.

What makes MADAAR creative is its combination of artificial intelligence, astronomical data analysis, and accessible visualization to approach one of the most exciting questions in astronomy.

Throughout development, our team considered data accuracy, efficiency, usability, and the importance of producing reliable results.
